stem: A lot label is unreadable and two candidate identities are possible from nearby inventory. What is the strongest immediate control?
choices: Choose the more likely identity from appearance
Prevent downstream mixing or movement and reconstruct identity from controlled genealogy and movement evidence
Split the material between both candidate lots
Create a new lot identity without linking the old genealogy
rationale: Ambiguous identity requires containment. Mixing or unsupported relabeling can permanently destroy genealogy and product identity.
